_doc: Expanded-minimap painted images, one per world id. img = path under the sanctuary-assets repo root (null = none yet, draw as today). Bounds are in GAME space = 2D tile coords = 3D scene coords (1 tile = 1 m; x east, 2D y == 3D z, +z south; north up). The image's left/right/top/bottom edges = minX/maxX/minZ/maxZ. Town (Martsirt 3D) grid is 162x154: scene = placements.json pos + origin [81,76]. Example entry: "town": {"img": "art_2d/maps/area_minimap_town.jpg", "minX": 0, "maxX": 162, "minZ": 0, "maxZ": 154}.
